name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) matches 'each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off'. The siren stays on until toggled and is off on the toggle step, so every ring closes at its toggle. The rule-only warning is valid because 'turn it off' is the consequent of 'each time', so no Existence is needed.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing, the agent turns it off: on every step where the siren is ringing, the siren switch is toggled on that step or later.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
